name: Appointment Scheduling Agent
headline: Turn the call into a booked appointment.
prompt: Let us find the right time for your visit.
description: Finds appropriate appointment availability and completes a booking through a conversational call. Identity, eligibility, scheduling constraints, and exception handling make this a more advanced integration scenario.
readiness: Illustrative workflow; validate identity, eligibility, availability, consent, accessibility, and exception handling.

business.application: Find appropriate appointment availability and complete a booking through a conversational call.
business.roi: Increase booked appointments, reduce scheduling calls, and extend access beyond office hours.
business.metrics: Bookings completed · Abandonment · Scheduler hours saved

technical.systems: Scheduling API · Patient identity · Eligibility rules
technical.build: Identity, appointment-type logic, availability search, booking, confirmation, and exception handling.

expected.description: Poster image for the video player (WebP).
